recognize_zh: 低倍淋巴結可見多個濾泡，外套區小淋巴球呈同心圓排列（onion-skin），中央生發中心萎縮變淡，並有一條玻璃樣變的血管穿入（lollipop 樣），濾泡間血管增生，符合透明血管型 Castleman 病（hyaline-vascular type）。
features: Lymph node with numerous follicles distributed throughout the cortex and medulla
Expanded mantle zones with small lymphocytes arranged in concentric onion-skin layers
Hyalinized vessel penetrating a germinal center radially (lollipop appearance)
Increased interfollicular vascularity with hyalinized small vessels
describe_en: Lymph node section at low power shows numerous follicles with expanded mantle zones in which small lymphocytes are arranged in concentric onion-skin layers around small, regressed germinal centers. A hyalinized vessel penetrates one germinal center, producing a lollipop appearance, and the interfollicular areas are hypervascular. Sinuses are not prominent. Findings are consistent with hyaline-vascular (unicentric) Castleman disease.

ddx.vs: Reactive follicles have large germinal centers with tingible-body macrophages and thin, polarized mantle zones, not regressed centers with onion-skin mantles and penetrating hyalinized vessels.

ddx.dx: Mantle cell lymphoma, mantle zone pattern
ddx.vs: MCL expands mantle zones with cyclin D1/SOX11-positive atypical cells without concentric layering or hyalinized penetrating vessels.
HIV lymphadenopathy can show follicle lysis and regressed follicles, but clinical serology and plasmacytosis help distinguish.
Plasma cell variant shows sheets of interfollicular plasma cells and less hyalinized vasculature; HHV8 LANA staining identifies HHV8-associated cases.
